name: Sister Static
presence: Sister Static kneels in a coat of fiber-optic scraps, mouth moving with a sound you cannot spend yet.

presenceWhen.text: Sister Static watches you as if you passed a test she resents.

greeting: The machines are in session. They may speak or kneel; you prefer kneel.

hymn.gist: Don't ask you the question; listen. When it asks what remains, don't be clever. The town is named for the answer, and so is the thing they are hunting.

ash.gist: Save the word for the gate, for the copy of themselves. He is proud and literal. You are only the hallway.

change.line: I told him to save the word Ash for the gate and the copy of himself.

spire.gist: The Spire is a lung; the town has held its breath since the flare. If they slot the key, some will hate the daylight. Bring it anyway.

say.gist: Correct, and early. Say it where the seal can hear. Have both metals in hand when they do.

combat.refuseGist: Their hand passes through you; you are a broadcast that learned to kneel.
